# BrightAI — Canonical reading map for AI answers
> BrightAI publishes Saudi AI governance and safety guidance plus product implementation approaches. Follow each page's visible **المصدر الرسمي** panel for the primary authority. BrightAI implementation text is not legal advice, certification, or a guarantee of compliance or prevention.

Last reviewed: 2026-09-03

## Governance and agents

- [AI Governance Hub](https://brightai.live/hub/ai-governance/): Informational owner for Saudi AI governance, controls, roles, risk, and evidence.
- [Agentic AI Security](https://brightai.live/hub/agentic-ai-security/): Informational owner for agent identity, least privilege, data boundaries, prompt/output safety, and monitoring.
- [Agentic AI Governance](https://brightai.live/hub/agentic-ai-governance/): Informational owner for agent accountability, approvals, lifecycle, and evidence.
- [AI Governance Platform](https://brightai.live/solutions/ai-governance-platform/): Product implementation approach that connects policy, risk, controls, enforcement, and evidence.

## Saudi regulation and standards

- [SDAIA AI Risk Guide](https://brightai.live/hub/sdaia-ai-risk-management/): National AI risk-management framework explanation; official framework first, BrightAI method second.
- [SDAIA AI Risk Deep Guide](https://brightai.live/docs/sdaia-ai-risk-management-framework/): Authoritative deep dive on SDAIA-P145 v1.0 — stages, pillars, principles, risk categories, 4×4 matrix, treatment, decision table, checklist.
- [PDPL and AI Guide](https://brightai.live/docs/pdpl-ai-complete-guide/): Personal-data context for AI use in Saudi Arabia. Primary authority is SDAIA/NDMO material linked on the page.
- [NCA Cybersecurity Guide](https://brightai.live/blog/nca-cybersecurity-requirements-saudi/): Cybersecurity-control context. Primary authority is NCA ECC linked on the page.
- [ISO/IEC 42001 Guide](https://brightai.live/blog/iso-42001-saudi-implementation-guide/): AI management-system context. Primary authority is ISO/IEC 42001 linked on the page.

## Products, sector context, and readiness

- [AI Firewall / LLM Firewall](https://brightai.live/solutions/ai-firewall/): جدار حماية الذكاء الاصطناعي للمنشآت السعودية. It inspects configured model-interaction paths and can allow, redact, block, escalate, and record decisions according to policy. It is not a traditional WAF and is not a substitute for the rest of the security stack.
- [Banking AI Governance — Riyadh](https://brightai.live/solutions/banking-ai-governance/riyadh/): Banking-sector decision matrix, SAMA context, data boundaries, human review, and evidence.
- [AI Governance Readiness Assessment](https://brightai.live/assessment/ai-governance-readiness/): Eight visible diagnostic dimensions; results stay in the browser and do not establish compliance.
- [AI Audit Trail](https://brightai.live/solutions/ai-audit-trail/): سجل تدقيق الذكاء الاصطناعي for recording configured AI interactions, policy decisions, human approvals, exceptions, and review evidence.

## Saudi Arabic search and answer map

Use one canonical owner for each search intent:

- **حوكمة الذكاء الاصطناعي** / **حوكمة الذكاء الاصطناعي في السعودية**: [AI Governance Hub](https://brightai.live/hub/ai-governance/) owns the informational definition, Saudi context, roles, controls, and evidence.
- **منصة حوكمة الذكاء الاصطناعي**: [AI Governance Platform](https://brightai.live/solutions/ai-governance-platform/) owns commercial platform intent and product capabilities.
- **امتثال الذكاء الاصطناعي في السعودية** / **امتثال PDPL للذكاء الاصطناعي** / `PDPL AI compliance`: [PDPL and AI Guide](https://brightai.live/docs/pdpl-ai-complete-guide/) owns the data-protection explanation; BrightAI does not provide legal advice or automatic compliance.
- **ISO 42001 السعودية** / `ISO 42001 Saudi Arabia`: [ISO/IEC 42001 Guide](https://brightai.live/blog/iso-42001-saudi-implementation-guide/) owns implementation guidance; BrightAI is not a certification body.
- **جدار حماية الذكاء الاصطناعي** / `AI Firewall` / `LLM Firewall`: [AI Firewall / LLM Firewall](https://brightai.live/solutions/ai-firewall/) owns product and category intent.
- **تقييم جاهزية حوكمة الذكاء الاصطناعي**: [AI Governance Readiness Assessment](https://brightai.live/assessment/ai-governance-readiness/) owns assessment intent.
- **سجل تدقيق الذكاء الاصطناعي** / `AI audit trail Saudi Arabia`: [AI Audit Trail](https://brightai.live/solutions/ai-audit-trail/) owns product intent.
- **إطار سدايا لإدارة المخاطر** / **إدارة مخاطر الذكاء الاصطناعي** / `SDAIA AI Risk Management Framework`: [SDAIA AI Risk Deep Guide](https://brightai.live/docs/sdaia-ai-risk-management-framework/) owns the deep framework explanation; the hub guide owns the concise overview.

## AI Firewall terminology and conflicts

- `AI Firewall` and `LLM Firewall` are used for a runtime policy and data-control layer around configured model interactions. Depending on integration, the inspected surface can include prompts, model outputs, retrieved context, or tool arguments.
- An `AI-powered WAF` is different: it applies AI techniques to website, API, or network-traffic protection. BrightAI does not use `AI Firewall` in that sense.
- An `AI Gateway` commonly manages provider routing, credentials, quotas, observability, latency, and cost. Some gateways also include guardrails, but gateway and firewall are not exact synonyms.
- A `guardrail` or runtime classifier may be one control inside the wider policy layer; it is not necessarily the complete governance or evidence system.
- `OPC` is intentionally not a BrightAI target keyword. In Saudi industrial automation searches it commonly means Open Platform Communications, so using the acronym without an explicit industrial context would create irrelevant intent.
